narrative: 用它把一个心智与后果分离开：超人般的感知力，一种想跳出方寸之地的愿望，一个被拉伸成一段步行的厨房瞬间。朱莉可以在一个静止的奥斯陆中奔跑。
快银可以在一个房间里做完世界其他人都无法完成的事。头发、天气、阴影和松散的物体，都必须遵守同一种冻结规则，否则这个幻觉就会破灭。
当整幅画面都应该静止（定格画面），当摄影机应该环绕一个被压缩的事件（子弹时间），或者当人群应该围绕一座雕像飞奔（延时人像）时，它就不是合适的工具。除非你想表达的是一张静止照片，否则不要把主角和街道一起冻结住。
how: 先确定规则：临时演员保持静止，液体和碎片悬停，主体和/或摄影机可以移动。用静止的临时演员和实体支撑物来完成简单的镜头，用视效或3D来完成复杂的悬停效果。
提示词：Frozen-in-motion of [Subject], the world stopped mid-gesture, particles hanging, [Subject] or the camera still allowed to move.
when: 当一个人应该走过一条静止的街道，或者在一个静止的厨房里干活，而鸽子和临时演员都悬停不动时使用。不要把它当作整个画面的定格，也不要让人群依然在飞奔。
vs: 动态冻结不是定格画面（摄影机和世界都停止）。它也不是子弹时间（事件被压缩，摄影机围绕一个雕塑般的场景运动）。
它也不是延时人像（人群飞奔，主角静止不动）。慢动作依然让所有人都在前进，只是变慢了。
把允许移动的对象列表写清楚。
examples_film: 《X战警：逆转未来》（X-Men: Days of Future Past）把快银在五角大楼厨房里的段落，扩展成一段其他人都无法共享的主观瞬间。《世界上最糟糕的人》（The Worst Person in the World）让朱莉在一个奥斯陆奔跑，而其他居民都被悬停住了。
《黑客帝国》（The Matrix）的天台戏是它的近亲——环绕运动式的子弹时间，而不是这种“谁能走动”的分离效果。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是定格画面、子弹时间，或延时人像。破绽是整幅画面完全静止，或者环绕一座雕像的运动，或者人群变成了一团烟雾。
解决办法是：写明冻结规则，让临时演员悬停，只让被选定的身体或摄影机继续移动。

faq.q: 电影中的动态冻结是什么？
faq.a: 动态冻结让世界大部分停止，同时被选定的人物和/或摄影机继续移动，让一个时钟从其余部分中分离出来。

faq.q: 动态冻结和子弹时间有什么区别？
faq.a: 子弹时间让摄影机围绕一个近乎冻结的事件走动。动态冻结让一个角色置身于一个静止的世界之中，而不仅仅是从环绕视角去审视它。

faq.q: 什么时候该用动态冻结？
faq.a: 当一个人的体验应该脱离世界的时钟时使用：在一座静止的城市中奔跑，在一个被冻结的厨房里做一件超人般的家务。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示动态冻结？
faq.a: 写明一个静止的环境、悬停的微粒，以及一份明确的许可清单：谁可以移动。除非你想要这些近亲效果，否则要禁止完全定格、飞奔的人群和阵列环绕运动。

narrative: Use it to separate a mind from consequence: superhuman perception, a wish to step outside a square, a kitchen instant stretched into a walk. Julie can run through a stopped Oslo.
Quicksilver can work a room the rest of the world cannot occupy. Hair, weather, shadows, and loose objects must obey the same freeze or the illusion dies.

It is the wrong tool when the whole picture should hold (freeze-frame), when the camera should orbit a crushed event (bullet time), or when crowds should race around a statue (timelapse human). Do not freeze the hero and the street together unless you mean a still.
how: Decide the rule: extras hold, fluids and debris are suspended, the subject and/or camera may travel. Use held extras and practical supports for simple beats, VFX or 3D for complex hangs.
Prompt: Frozen-in-motion of [Subject], the world stopped mid-gesture, particles hanging, [Subject] or the camera still allowed to move.
when: Use it when one person should walk a stopped street, or work a stopped kitchen, while pigeons and extras hang. Do not use it as a freeze of the entire frame, and do not race the crowd.
vs: Frozen in motion is not Freeze Frame (camera and world both stop). It is not Bullet Time (event crushed, camera orbits a sculpture).
It is not Timelapse Human (crowd races, hero holds). Slow Motion still advances everyone, only slower.
examples_film: X-Men: Days of Future Past expands Quicksilver's Pentagon kitchen into a subjective instant the others cannot share. The Worst Person in the World lets Julie run through an Oslo whose other inhabitants are suspended.
The Matrix rooftop is the orbiting cousin, bullet time, not this split of who may walk.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Freeze Frame, Bullet Time, or Timelapse Human. The tell is a fully still picture, an orbit around a statue, or people as smoke.
Fix: write the freeze rule, hang the extras, and let only the chosen body or camera continue.

faq.q: What is Frozen in Motion in film?
faq.a: Frozen in motion stops most of the world while a chosen person and/or the camera keep moving, so one clock splits from the rest.

faq.q: Frozen in Motion vs Bullet Time
faq.a: Bullet time walks the camera around a nearly frozen event. Frozen in motion lets a character inhabit a stopped world, not only inspect it from an orbit.

faq.q: When should I use Frozen in Motion?
faq.a: When one person's experience should leave the world's clock: a run through a stopped city, a superhuman chore in a held kitchen.

faq.q: How do I prompt Frozen in Motion for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a stopped environment, hanging particles, and a clear permission: who may move. Ban a full freeze, a racing crowd, and an array orbit unless you want those cousins.
